say: Mariano's collector 1.10.0rc5 (commit bc19afe), recorded on Hamza's own Azure test VM (Ubuntu 24.04),
not on the client's VM. Store: Mariano's Vernon Hills 53100502, PICKUP. Provider: Oxylabs Web API,
Hamza's trial credit, every submission reserved in the shared trial ledger before it is sent.
Every command below runs for real while it is recorded; nothing is edited afterwards. The published
copy masks private identifiers (host name, paths) and nothing else.
The run shown is the logical full run 01M7JNB2HDFCNR3GHQVX8FYXX6, read in slices; this is its last slice (M-F2d-full-run-110rc5-20261116).
The run as the collector records it: interrupted by the operator's SIGTERM that ended the previous slice,
resumable.
The shared trial ledger: hash chain, active lease, what Mariano's can still spend.

argv: mstage ledger-status | python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); m=d["projects"]["marianos"]; print("chain", d["chain"], "| lease", d["active_lease"], "| Mariano\x27s committed", m["committed_usd"], "| spendable", m["spendable_in_envelope_usd"], "| held unknown", m["unknown_rows"], "rows")'

say: Resume the run as a service (it survives a lost SSH session), two lanes, and follow its log. After 6 pages
it is stopped with SIGTERM (systemctl stop): the collector records a resumable stop (exit 75).
A second start for the store while it has an unfinished run is refused before any request: the harness
gives it a gate that refuses every submission, and none is even attempted (exit 9).
Resume again: the run goes on until this slice's ceiling, the last of the trial credit, before the whole
scope. At the ceiling the collector stops (exit 4) and finalizes the run itself: its records are
exported as a partial dataset, which is never published.
An attempt to publish it:
Publication refused (exit 6): only a complete run is published; nothing was published or replaced.
The coverage of the CSV rows as the run left them:
Records traced to the stored page they were read from (its SHA-256 checked), and the tile read again
independently of the collector:

argv: mstage ledger-status | python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); m=d["projects"]["marianos"]; print("chain", d["chain"], "| lease", d["active_lease"], "| Mariano\x27s committed", m["committed_usd"], "| spendable", m["spendable_in_envelope_usd"], "| held unknown", m["unknown_rows"], "rows")'
systemctl list-units --no-legend 'marianos-*'; echo "(units listed above; none means no collector process is left running)"

say: End of the walkthrough. Not shown here, and still open: the full scope (beyond the trial credit), the
client's VM (a separately authorized window), the twice-weekly schedule (blocked until a protected
full publication) and the client's own review.
